item.title: Why You're Exhausted Even After 8 Hours of Sleep
item.description:
You slept eight hours. You still feel wrecked. Traditional Chinese Medicine has a different answer — and it isn't "sleep more."

Discover the TCM Organ Clock, why your Liver and Spleen might be behind your exhaustion, and four practical things you can try starting tonight.

item.title: Why I'm Sharing Ancient Chinese Wisdom with the West
item.description:
In an age of accelerating AI and anxiety, the 1,800-year-old philosophy of the Shanghan Lun offers something our world desperately needs.

Why a full-time international trade professional started a blog about classical Chinese medicine — and why the timing matters.
